fn valid_identifier(value: &str) -> bool {
    !value.is_empty()
        && value.len() <= 128
        && value
            .bytes()
            .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'-' | b'_' | b'.'))
}

pub fn is_valid(&self) -> bool {
        self.resources.positive()
            && self.resources.instances == 1
            && !self.options.is_empty()
            && self.options.len() <= MAX_OPTIONS_BYTES
            && self.startup_deadline_ms > 0
            && self.timeout_ms > 0
            && self.timeout_ms <= self.max_lifetime_ms
            && self
                .startup_deadline_ms
                .checked_add(self.max_lifetime_ms)
                .is_some()
    }

pub fn is_valid(&self) -> bool {
        self.user.len() <= 64
            && self
                .user
                .bytes()
                .next()
                .is_some_and(|c| c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == b'_')
            && self
                .user
                .bytes()
                .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"_-".contains(&c))
            && self.workdir.starts_with('/')
            && self.workdir.len() <= 4096
            && !self.workdir.contains(['\0', '\\'])
            && !self.workdir.split('/').any(|part| part == "..")
            && self.env_vars.len() <= 256
            && self.env_vars.iter().all(|(key, value)| {
                key.bytes()
                    .next()
                    .is_some_and(|c| c.is_ascii_alphabetic() || c == b'_')
                    && key.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == b'_')
                    && key.len() + value.len() <= 8192
                    && !value.contains('\0')
            })
            && self.argv.len() <= 256
            && self
                .argv
                .iter()
                .all(|arg| arg.len() <= 8192 && !arg.contains('\0'))
            && self.argv.first().is_none_or(|command| !command.is_empty())
            && self
                .env_vars
                .iter()
                .map(|(key, value)| key.len() + value.len())
                .sum::<usize>()
                + self.argv.iter().map(String::len).sum::<usize>()
                <= 32 * 1024
    }
